fusions.name: Gaff Heave
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, up to 6 tiles away. Hooks it with a claw for 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Snag Quill
fusions.desc: Flings a barbed scale that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drag Line
fusions.desc: Lays a barbed line 6 tiles long for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Whenever you inflict a condition on an enemy, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
